none: PAS BUC-468931: A silver groat of ?Edward III
contea di ritrovamento: Oxfordshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A silver groat Edward IV, 2nd c.1471, type XX. Obverse :EDWARD DI GRA REX ANGL HI FRANC, Reverse inner legend reads "CIVI TAS LOn DOn" using Lombardic rather than Roman N's. Outer reverse legend reads +POSVI DEVMA DIVTOR E*DEVM where the * indicates a "Rose" or "Half Sun / Rose". Identification kindly provided by Steve Blencoe
